title: Étude de l'Impact Environnemental et Social du sous projet de mise en place d'un centre de données (DATACENTER) national au PK5, Arrondissement Communal Niamey II
why_not: Pre-construction impact study (August 2022): planned mains supply from NIGELEC with generator backup and an estimated 35 m3/day water need; facility not in service and no secured supply, PUE or published water use stated. Conservative: not selected.
